_comment: One Jev request per photo. The {n}-tagged questions are repeated for each slot up to max_subjects ({n} = 'largest', '2nd largest', ...). {photo} is filled in automatically.

count.instructions: How many separate animals (insects, birds or other creatures) are clearly visible in {photo}?

view.instructions: How is the {n} animal in {photo} seen by the camera?

criteria.top: from above or below: its back or belly faces the camera (e.g. a moth or butterfly with its wings spread flat)
criteria.side: in profile: its side faces the camera (e.g. a butterfly with its wings closed upright, a perched bird)

object.instructions: Draw a tight box around the whole of the {n} animal in {photo}, including wings, antennae, legs and tail.

head.instructions: Draw a tight box around just the head of the {n} animal in {photo}.

feet_visible.instructions: Are the feet or legs of the {n} animal in {photo} visible, and is it clear which way is down for it?

feet.instructions: Draw a tight box around the feet (or the ends of the legs) of the {n} animal in {photo}.
